headline: NQ is −1.3% after Alphabet's double miss (stock −10% premarket), pointing to a cash open below Wednesday's NDX low. Small short while NQ stays under its overnight high; the gap is big enough to fill, and Amazon/Intel report after the close.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · ECB 9:15 AM ET · AMZN/INTC after the close

flip.long: NQ reclaims the overnight high 29,794.25 (≈ NDX 29,628, right at Wednesday's 29,618 low), which would mean the Alphabet gap is being bought. Stronger back above Wednesday's settle 29,979.50.
flip.short: Stays SHORT while NQ is below 29,794.25. Adds conviction on a break of the overnight low 29,482.50 (≈ NDX 29,316, under Tuesday's 29,340 low), especially with the 10-year holding above 5.00%.

thesis: There's a small short edge at the open, low conviction. The NDX rose 0.5% Wednesday to 29,813.16 (range 29,618.42–29,848.71) ahead of the Fed [1]. After the close, **Alphabet reported its first EPS and revenue double miss since 2022**, with Search missing again and free cash flow negative ~$9B on AI spending; the stock is about −10% premarket, on track for its worst post-earnings reaction ever [3,4,5]. Microsoft is +2–4% on 48% Azure growth and lower capex guidance, but software and chips are being sold with Alphabet (ServiceNow about −18 to −20%, Fortinet about −25%, Marvell −11%, AMD and Intel lower) [3,5,6]. **NQ is −403 pts / −1.34% at 29,576.50 (8:37 AM ET)**, in the lower half of a 29,482.50–29,794.25 overnight range [2]. With a ~166-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~29,410, **below Wednesday's 29,618 low and Tuesday's 29,651 close**, a clean gap out of the prior range [1,2]. Macro doesn't help: the 8:30 data was hot on growth (Q3 GDP 3.4% vs ~3.2%) and in line on inflation (core PCE 0.3% m/m, 3.1% y/y), which keeps a December hike (~81% priced) on the table, and the 10-year is back at ~5.02% [7,8,9]. Oil is mixed (WTI ~$101.7 flat, Brent ~$110.5) and the dollar is a touch firmer at ~102.1 [9]. So the call is **a small SHORT while NQ stays under its overnight high**, but the gap is already large, so expect two-way trade and size down into Amazon tonight.

bullets.label: The gap is down and out of Wednesday's range.
bullets.text: NQ is −1.3% at 29,576.50 in the lower half of its 29,482.50–29,794.25 overnight range [2]. On a ~166-pt premium, that implies a cash open around ~29,410, below Wednesday's 29,618 low and Tuesday's 29,651 close, which breaks the three-day rebound [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: A megacap catalyst, and it's spreading.
bullets.text: Alphabet missed on EPS and revenue, Search missed for a second quarter, and free cash flow was −$9.07B; the stock is about −10% premarket [3,4,5]. The selling is spreading to software and chips (ServiceNow, Fortinet, Marvell, AMD, Intel), while Dow futures are higher, so it's a tech-specific move [3,5,6]. Microsoft's +2–4% on Azure is the main offset [4,6].

bullets.label: Macro leans hawkish.
bullets.text: GDP beat (3.4% vs ~3.2%) and core PCE was in line at 0.3% m/m, 3.1% y/y, so nothing argues for easier policy; December hike odds are ~81% after Wednesday's 10–2 hold with two hike dissents [7,8,3]. The 10-year is ~5.02% and VIX is slightly higher at ~17.1 [9].

bullets.label: The morning is the clean window.
bullets.text: Still to come: the ECB decision (9:15 AM ET) and press conference, then Amazon and Intel after the close (Amazon call 5:00 PM ET) [6,10]. No Fed speakers were found on today's calendar.

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: A −1.3% gap on one company's miss can fill fast, especially with Microsoft green, strong GDP, in-line core PCE, Merck beating, and oil off its highs [4,6,7]. Buy-the-dip flows into Amazon's report could pull NQ back to the overnight high and Wednesday's range.

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: This is the AI-spending worry from last week's selloff coming back: investors are punishing capex without monetization, and Alphabet is a large NDX weight [3,4]. With the 10-year at 5% and a December hike mostly priced, there's little rate relief to cushion tech, and a break of Tuesday's low opens the Oct 22–23 lows [1,3,9].

bullets.label: Stay/scale SHORT:
bullets.text: Cash NDX stays below Wednesday's 29,618 low (≈ NQ 29,785) through the first 30 minutes. Add on a break of the NQ overnight low 29,482.50 and Tuesday's 29,340 NDX low, ideally with GOOGL making new lows and the 10-year above 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ reclaims the overnight high 29,794.25 (≈ NDX 29,628) and holds, meaning the gap is being bought. Stronger on a move back toward Wednesday's settle 29,979.50.

bullets.label: Flip to STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: If the open chops between the overnight low and high (29,482.50–29,794.25) with no follow-through in the first 30 minutes, there's no edge. Cut size into the close either way with Amazon and Intel after the bell.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: The ECB at 9:15 AM ET, US–Iran headlines ahead of the Nov 3 midterms and oil, and any early read-through to Amazon's AWS and capex [6,10].
